question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**book**" is most appropriate to use in this context.
 
• A "**guide**" is a book that provides information or instructions about a topic but isn't suitable here.
 
• A "**manual**" is a handbook or a set of instructions, usually for technical items, and doesn't fit here.
 
• A "**text**" can refer to any written content but isn't the specific word usually used to refer to literary works for personal enjoyment.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *It has now become my favourite book__.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Guide**: A book that provides information or instructions about a specific topic.
 
• **Manual**: A handbook or a set of instructions, typically for technical items or procedures.
 
• **Text**: Written or printed words and passages, but not specifically referring to literary works meant for enjoyment.
